title: plugin-list: `ListView`'s `$select` harvest has no `rowColor` arm, so a list tinted by a field that is not a column fetches rows without that field and paints nothing
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect, measured in a browser.
`reach:` the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.1 (HotCRM `main` `f4ac253f` + PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2108), light theme, measured by the `repo:hotcrm` seat's dev on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2107: two lists that declare a `rowColor` on a non-column field paint no row.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01P8mZuzuyZAHSrgQKmv6ASv`) from its dev's report on #2107. The seat re-read the producer on objectui `origin/main` `df05784`. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: objectui triage, then the lane that owns `packages/plugin-list`.
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open + closed): "rowColor field not in $select projection row color field not fetched list view" → 6 hits, all closed: objectui#10370 (the same harvest's missing `map` arm, the closest sibling), objectui#10277, objectui#10186, objectui#7218 (`rowColor` relayed to `ListView`), objectui#7216, objectui#758. "useRowColor undefined value color by non-column field select omits" → 3 hits: objectui#12375 (open, the dark theme and frozen columns, a different defect), objectui#7243, objectui#758. None covers the projection.

## What happens

| list (HotCRM) | declared | fetch `select=` | rows painted |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| All Accounts (`/_console/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_account`), one account set `is_active = false` | `rowColor: { field: 'is_active', colors: { false: 'slate' } }` | `id,name,industry,type,annual_revenue,number_of_employees,health_score` (no `is_active`) | 0 of 9; the inactive row is untinted |
| Cases, Unassigned — triage, one unowned case with `is_sla_violated = true` | `rowColor: { field: 'is_sla_violated', colors: { true: 'red' } }` | `…,sla_due_date,is_escalated,is_closed,owner_id` (no `is_sla_violated`) | 0 of 2 |
| **control:** Cases, All Cases, where `is_sla_violated` **is** a column | same map | carries `is_sla_violated` | all 13 flagged rows `bg-red-100` |

The author gets no warning. The key validates, lints and publishes clean, then paints nothing at runtime.

## Producer (read on objectui `origin/main` `df05784`)

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, `selectFields` (from about line 2656): the projection is the columns, plus the view bindings (`collectViewFields` for kanban, calendar, gallery, timeline, gantt and, since objectui#10370, map), plus `collectGroupingFieldRefs(groupingConfig)` through `addSpeculative`, plus the predicate operands (`listViewPredicates({ conditionalFormatting, … })`). `rowColorConfig.field` has no arm, so it reaches the row only when it happens to be a column.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/useRowColor.ts` then reads `row[config.field]` as `undefined`, which matches no key, so the row gets no class.
- The spec's `ListViewSchema.rowColor.field` ("Field whose value is looked up in the `colors` map below to pick a row colour") sets no column requirement, so a non-column field is a legal declaration.

## Fix direction (for the implementer to measure, ⛔ not a ruling)

- Give the harvest a `rowColor` arm: `addSpeculative(rowColorConfig.field)`, the same FLS-gated path grouping uses (objectui#7216). A field the viewer cannot read stays out of `$select`, and `ListView` already drops the whole `rowColor` for that viewer (`canReadField`, around line 4779).
- Read `rowColorConfig`, the state a user's pick in the toolbar's Color section can replace, not `schema.rowColor`, so the projection follows the colour the list actually draws. Add it to the fetch effect's dependencies if it is not already there.

## Acceptance

A list whose `rowColor.field` is not a column fetches that field (when the viewer can read it) and tints its matching rows. A pin sits beside objectui#10370's map pin in the projection tests.

Blocks objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2107 (two of its four kept tints wait for this fix; the app does not add a column to dodge it, HotCRM AGENTS.md §2).
